questions.prompt: In the Hero's Quest, which stage comes first?
questions.explain: The Hero's Quest starts with The Ordinary World.

questions.prompt: In the Hero's Quest, which stage comes last?
choices: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.answer: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: The quest ends with the Return to the Ordinary World: Reward.

questions.prompt: Which stage comes right after The Ordinary World?
questions.explain: The Call to Adventure follows The Ordinary World.

questions.prompt: Which stage is at the highest point of the line in the Hero's Quest diagram?
questions.explain: The Ordeal is the peak of the quest.

questions.prompt: Which stage comes right after The Ordeal?
questions.explain: The Road Back comes after The Ordeal.

questions.prompt: Which stage comes right before The Ordeal?
choices: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: The Trials come just before The Ordeal.

questions.prompt: Complete the stage name: The Call to ___
questions.explain: The second stage is The Call to Adventure.

questions.prompt: Complete the stage name: The Road ___
questions.explain: The stage after The Ordeal is The Road Back.

questions.prompt: Complete the stage name: Return to the Ordinary World: ___
questions.explain: The last stage is the Return to the Ordinary World: Reward.

questions.prompt: Which three things are part of the Trials?
choices: The call, the ordeal, the reward
Refusal, the road back, the reward
Refusal, meeting the mentor, crossing the threshold
Meeting the mentor, the ordeal, the return
questions.answer: Refusal, meeting the mentor, crossing the threshold
questions.explain: The Trials are refusal, meeting the mentor and crossing the threshold.

questions.prompt: The Trials include refusal, meeting the ___ and crossing the threshold.
questions.explain: Meeting the mentor is one part of the Trials.

questions.prompt: In which stage does the hero's refusal happen?
choices: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: Refusal is one part of the Trials.

questions.prompt: In which stage does the hero meet the mentor?
choices: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: Meeting the mentor is one part of the Trials.

questions.prompt: In which stage does the hero get the reward?
choices: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.answer: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: The reward comes with the return to the Ordinary World.

questions.prompt: Which comes later in the Hero's Quest? (The Call to Adventure / Trials)
questions.explain: The Trials come after The Call to Adventure.

questions.prompt: Which list shows the first four stages in the correct order?
choices: The Ordinary World, Trials, The Call to Adventure, The Ordeal
The Ordinary World, The Call to Adventure, Trials, The Ordeal
The Call to Adventure, The Ordinary World, Trials, The Ordeal
The Ordinary World, The Call to Adventure, The Ordeal, Trials
questions.answer: The Ordinary World, The Call to Adventure, Trials, The Ordeal
questions.explain: The order is Ordinary World, Call to Adventure, Trials, Ordeal.

questions.prompt: Which list shows the last four stages in the correct order?
choices: Trials, The Ordeal, The Road Back, Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
Trials, The Road Back, The Ordeal, Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
The Ordeal, Trials, The Road Back, Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
Trials, The Ordeal, Return to the Ordinary World: Reward, The Road Back
questions.answer: Trials, The Ordeal, The Road Back, Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: The order is Trials, Ordeal, Road Back, Return to the Ordinary World: Reward.

questions.prompt: In the diagram, is the line going up or down during The Road Back? (up / down)
questions.explain: After the peak at The Ordeal, the line goes down.

questions.prompt: In the diagram, is the line going up or down during the Trials? (up / down)
questions.explain: The line rises towards The Ordeal.

questions.prompt: Mira feeds the chickens and helps at the market every day. Nothing unusual has happened yet. Which stage is this?
questions.explain: Everyday life before the adventure is The Ordinary World.

questions.prompt: One morning, a messenger arrives at Tomas's farm and asks him to save the kingdom from a storm-witch. Which stage is this?
choices: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: Being asked to start an adventure is The Call to Adventure.

questions.prompt: Aino is afraid and says no to the quest at first. Which stage is this?
choices: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: Refusal is part of the Trials.

questions.prompt: An old sailor teaches the young hero how to fight and gives her wise advice. Which part of the Trials is this?
questions.explain: A wise teacher who guides the hero is the mentor.

questions.prompt: Ravi leaves his village and walks through the gate into a dark forest he has never seen. Which part of the Trials is this?
questions.explain: Leaving the known world for a new one is crossing the threshold.

questions.prompt: After many days, the hero faces the terrible beast in its cave. It is the most dangerous moment of the story. Which stage is this?
choices: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: The most dangerous test is The Ordeal.

questions.prompt: The hero has the magic stone and starts the journey back to her village. The beast is far behind. Which stage is this?
questions.explain: Heading back home after the danger is The Road Back.

questions.prompt: The hero is home again. The villagers cheer and give him a medal. Which stage is this?
choices: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.answer: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: Coming home and getting a prize is the Return to the Ordinary World: Reward.

questions.prompt: What is a mentor?
choices: A monster that guards a treasure
An experienced person who guides and teaches the hero
A young person who is learning to fight
questions.answer: An experienced person who guides and teaches the hero
questions.explain: A mentor guides and teaches the hero.

questions.prompt: What is an ordeal?
choices: A happy party after a victory
A very difficult and painful experience or test
A message asking someone to go
questions.answer: A very difficult and painful experience or test
questions.explain: An ordeal is a very hard test.

questions.prompt: What is a reward?
choices: Something given for a good or brave action
questions.answer: Something given for a good or brave action
questions.explain: A reward is a prize for what you did.

questions.prompt: What is a threshold?
choices: The highest point of a mountain
The end of a long journey
The line or doorway you cross to enter a new place
questions.answer: The line or doorway you cross to enter a new place
questions.explain: The threshold is the entrance; crossing it means starting something new.

questions.prompt: What does refusal mean?
questions.explain: A refusal is a no.

questions.prompt: A long and difficult search or journey to reach an important goal is called a ___. (quest / ordeal / threshold / mentor)
questions.explain: A quest is a long search or journey to reach an important goal.

questions.prompt: A person who guides and teaches the hero is called a ___. (mentor / reward / quest / ordeal)
questions.explain: That guide is the mentor.

questions.prompt: Beowulf hears in Geatland that King Hrothgar is in trouble and needs help. Which stage of the Hero's Quest is this?
choices: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: Hearing about a problem and being asked to help is The Call to Adventure.

questions.prompt: Beowulf returns to Geatland, where he is welcomed as a hero. Which stage of the Hero's Quest is this?
choices: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.answer: Return to the Ordinary World: Reward
questions.explain: Coming home and being welcomed as a hero is the Return to the Ordinary World: Reward.
